# Learned instinct: gitlab-runner-tags-required (confidence 0.95)

All CI/CD jobs must specify explicit runner `tags:`. Jobs without tags can run on any shared runner, which violates PCI least-privilege (Req 7.2) for deployment jobs. Deployment jobs must run on tagged deploy runners; build jobs on tagged build runners. Never use untagged runners for secrets access.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 7.2; GitLab CI runner documentation
